description: Run a Search.loinc query for (Component: Procedure note Scale: Doc). From the export, create a comma-separated list of codes. Then, append the following codes, which represent common procedures for which notes are generated but whose LOINC component does not explicitly state “procedure note”: 18744-3, 18745-0, 18746-8, 18751-8, 18836-7, 29757-2, 33721-2, 47048-4, 48807-2. Add the  comma separated list to the definition with Operator "in" to the "Code field"
purpose: (Clinical Focus: Procedure note classified by physiological system and procedure),(Data Element Scope: This set is intended for use in representing clinical procedure notes, including certain common procedures where notes are generated even if the terminology does not explicitly label them as "procedure notes."),(Inclusion Criteria: LOINC document concepts representing a procedure where component = 'procedure note' and scale = 'DOC (plus select code where component contains additional text to "procedure note"),(Exclusion Criteria: LOINC Document codes that are not procedure-focused)
